bela.m: Welcome to Fallhaven Tavern. Have a seat anywhere.
r: Let me see what food and drinks you have available.
Torilo suggested that I ask other tavern owners such as yourself about a 'business agreement' that you may have with a group of 'distributors'.
Please keep these {4850} gold coins for safekeeping. Rain asked for you until he gets over his hangover, he'll come collect them when he is ready.
Come on. You know who Torilo is.

bela_beer_10.m: No, really, I don't know anyone by that name.
r: Sure you do. He is the owner of the Foaming flask.

bela_beer_20.m: the 'Foaming flask', what is that? Is that a tavern?
r: I've had enough of you. If you want to play dumb, then I don't have time for you.

bela_gsnake_1.m: I'm glad you are still alive!
r: As you know I can handle myself.

bela_gsnake_10.m: Oh no - what have I done? I shouldn't have talked of the giant snake. Promise me you won't go there!
r: Well, if it makes you happy.

bela_gsnake_11.m: What a waste of such a young, promising life! Well...don't forget to pay your tab before you leave my tavern.

bela_gsnake_2.m: Did you not hear of the most dangerous snake ever seen? It has been spotted on Fallhaven's southern border.
r:
No, I didn't hear, and I also don't want to.
Please give me something to drink.
Sure. And your little snake monster is no more.

bela_gsnake_21.m: Incredible! Let's feast now! Everyone have a free drink!

bela_gsnake_3.m: No normal snake. Huge as a house! Making noise like a hundred galloping horses!

bela_gsnake_4.m: Few people dare to walk outside of the city nowadays.
r: Thanks for the warning. I'll avoid that area.

bela_gsnake_5.m: Good. Enough of such dark words - now go, have a seat anywhere.
r: Let me see what food and drinks you have available.

bela_lytwing_strawberries.m: I don't, but I believe the potion merchant here in Fallhaven has some.

bela_rain.m: Definitely. Count on me. Glad you could help him, the poor sod.

bela_rain_gold_10.m: What is more important than a kidnapping?
r: Please keep these {4850} gold coins for safekeeping. Rain has asked for you until he gets over his hangover, he'll come collect them when he is ready.

bela_room_1.m: A room will cost you only 10 gold.
r: I really need to rest but I don't have 10 gold. I will wash the dishes. [Wash the dishes]

bela_room_2.m: OK. Take the last room down at the end of the hall.
r: Thank you. There was something else I wanted to talk about.

bela_room_3.m: I hope the room suits your needs. It's the last room down at the end of the hall.
r: Thank you. There was something else I wanted to talk about.

bela_trade_1.m: I have a variety of food and drinks.

bela_trade_2.m: I have some new soup now, from Gison and Nimael. It's expensive, but worth the money.

bela_witch_10.m: Did you hear about the kidnapping?
r: Not now, I have something else to talk about.

bela_witch_15.m: [Looking extermely confused and terrified] ... Well, why would it be you?

bela_witch_20.m: Well, while you were off hunting and killing that giant snake, I had a customer.

bela_witch_25.m: A customer with a very interesting report about a kidnapped girl and a witch.

bela_witch_30.m: That's the thing. He is no longer here. He just left before you walked in.

bela_witch_31.m: You should ask around town if anyone has seen or heard about it.
r: OK. I think I will do that. Thanks.
OK, but first please give me something to drink.

gison_soup.10:
In a hut southwest from Fallhaven I met Alaun.
He asked me to bring him some of the delicious soup made by Gison with forest mushrooms.
Gison's house lies to the south.
gison_soup.20: I found Gison's house and should deliver the soup to Alaun while it is hot.
gison_soup.22: Gison gave me a new soup for 5 gold.
gison_soup.24: Gison gave me a new soup for 50 gold.
gison_soup.26: Gison gave me a new soup for 500 gold.
gison_soup.28: Gison gave me a new soup for 5000 gold. I should really go to Alaun now.
gison_soup.30:
Alaun received the soup.
I should take the empty bottle back to Gison.
gison_soup.35: Alaun told me that Nimael also makes soup.
gison_soup.40: Gison thanked me for bringing the empty bottle back to him.
gison_soup.50:
I spent 5555 gold on buying mushroom soup! Am I crazy? 
There is no soup left for Alaun now.
gison_soup.60: Gison insisted his soup is better than Nimael's.
gison_soup.70: Nimael insisted her soup is better than Gison's.
gison_soup.80: Gison gave me a taste of both soups.
gison_soup.90: Nimael gave me a taste of both soups.
gison_soup.100: Gison said he would talk to Nimael about selling both soups in Fallhaven.
gison_soup.110: Nimael said she would talk to Gison about selling both soups in Fallhaven.
gison_soup.120: Nimael and Gison have been successful in selling more soup in Fallhaven by cooperating and creating more recipes.

fallhaven_lytwings.1: I met Arensia in Fallhaven. She is being taunted by lytwings while she slumbers. I agreed to help get rid of the mischevious creatures. I should talk to Rigmor to find out more, she lives north of the tavern.
fallhaven_lytwings.10: Rigmor told me that lytwings live near large rings of mushroom growth, I should look for these in the forest surrounding Fallhaven.
fallhaven_lytwings.11: I have to take a gift of two red apples and two strawberries before I can talk to the lytwings. They cast some kind of spell on me for not bringing them these fruit, it made me feel very tired.
fallhaven_lytwings.12: The lytwings accepted my gift, and I can now talk with them.
fallhaven_lytwings.13: I offered my help to the lytwings in exchange for leaving Arensia alone. They are considering my request. I should check in with them shortly, to hear their decision.
fallhaven_lytwings.20: The lytwings asked that I chop down a gnarly old tree that is inside their mushroom ring. They insisted that I use an iron axe because the cursed bark of the tree cannot be cut by other tools.
fallhaven_lytwings.21: I was about to swing my axe, when the lytwings stopped me. They have changed their minds about chopping down the tree. I am beginning to think they are indecisive on purpose.
fallhaven_lytwings.30: The lytwings want four bottles of mead. I can probably find some at the Fallhaven tavern.
fallhaven_lytwings.31: They took the mead, and turned around saying they want something else. I can now see why Rigmor said they are full of mischief! But I have no other choice but to continue this fool's errand if I want to help Arensia.
fallhaven_lytwings.40: I have to find twelve wild flowers for the lytwings. I wonder where I could find those. Perhaps Arensia will know.
fallhaven_lytwings.41: They accepted the flowers, and as expected, said they want something else! How many more times will they make me run around?
fallhaven_lytwings.90: The lytwings want a token of Arensia's promise that she will not to pick their mushrooms again. I sense they are not playing another prank this time, they seemed intent about this task.
fallhaven_lytwings.91: Arensia made a promise to her mother's ring, and then she gave it to me. I should take it to the lytwings at once.
fallhaven_lytwings.92: I gave Arensia's ring to the lytwings. Just when I thought it was done, they said they need something else! I am waiting on their decision.
fallhaven_lytwings.99: The lytwings have agreed to stop taunting Arensia. I should go tell her.
fallhaven_lytwings.100: Arensia was elated to hear that the lytwings will no longer taunt her.
fallhaven_lytwings.101: I could not take the absurd errands any more. I am no longer helping Arensia with her lytwing problem.
fallhaven_lytwings.102: I lied to Arensia's and kept her mother's ring for myself.
fallhaven_lytwings.103: Arensia gave me her magical promise ring as reward for helping her.

wicked_witch.10: Bela, the Fallhaven tavern keeper heard from a customer about a possible kidnapping of a girl. I should ask around town if anyone knows more.
wicked_witch.20: The "busy farmer", in the southeastern part of Fallhaven knows something about the witch.
wicked_witch.30: The "busy farmer" and his best friend, Addie, were kept captive by the witch a very long time ago when they were just kids. He never saw Addie again.
wicked_witch.40: The "busy farmer" told me that the witch's house is just south of Fallhaven. Covered in beautiful flowers.
wicked_witch.50: After meeting Bonicksa, the wicked witch, I decided to let her live and she did likewise, but not before leaving me with a very cryptic response. Saying I was "confident in my path" and that "we shall see". I wonder what that meant?
wicked_witch.60: I killed what I thought was Bonicksa, but I quickly realized that I killed an innocent girl.
wicked_witch.65: I "killed" Bonicksa again, only for her to reappear.
wicked_witch.70: Bonicksa lives and could not be defeated. But I learned a huge life lesson.
wicked_witch.80: I discovered a young girl named Emmeline just behind the 'wicked witch's' house. The witch was really Emmeline under a spell from Bonicksa.
wicked_witch.85: Emmeline asked me to get her "a lot" of those "Tonics of Blood".
wicked_witch.90: Emmeline told me to head east of the witch's house to find the undead that know about the 'Tonic of Blood'.
wicked_witch.95: I gave Emmeline 25 of the "Tonics of Blood" that she asked for and she was then able to leave that terrible place.
wicked_witch.96: I gave Emmeline 20 of the 25 "Tonics of Blood" that she asked for and she was then able to leave that terrible place.

bela_gsnake.10: I heard rumours of a giant snake to the south of Fallhaven.
bela_gsnake.90: Bela was happy that I freed Fallhaven from the threat of this monstrous snake.

undertell_barricades.10: I asked Myrelis how to get the barricades to Undertell removed and he told me to meet his friend Shannal inside the beach-scene house.
undertell_barricades.20: I met Shannal and she said I had to prove myself before she would remove the barriers. She feared that I am not ready to enter Undertell.
undertell_barricades.40: Shannal gave me a special Traders' Guild bronze coin and asked me to show it to Benbyr north of Fallhaven.
undertell_barricades.60: A frightened Benbyr told me these coins were payments his ancestor received for kidnapping people to work in the mines of Undertell.
undertell_barricades.70: Benbyr asked me to help save him from Shannal.
undertell_barricades.80: Shannal told me she did not want to kill Benbyr. She wanted him to pay toward helping her descendant, the drunkard named Rain who sleeps outside the Fallhaven Tavern.
undertell_barricades.90: Shannal asked me to help cure Rain by giving him one of Lodar's Potion of Heightened Senses and whatever I can get of value from Benbyr. But I should visit Benbyr first.
undertell_barricades.100: Benbyr offered me fifty gold to keep the matter quiet. I refused.
undertell_barricades.110: Benbyr then offered 500 gold. I still refused.
undertell_barricades.120: Benbyr became terrified and handed over 5000 gold.
undertell_barricades.130: I gave one of Lodar's Potion of Heightened Senses to drunkard outside the Fallhaven tavern, and he remembered his time in Undertell.
undertell_barricades.140: I assured Rain that Shannal was at peace and gave him the 5000 gold Benbyr had given me. He told me to keep the money safe with Bela until his hangover passed.
undertell_barricades.150: I entrusted 4850 gold to Bela for safekeeping. She agreed to hold it.
undertell_barricades.160: Shannal thanked me for helping Rain and warned me to be careful. She removed the barricades in front of the entrance to Undertell.

remgard.10: I have reached the bridge to enter the town of Remgard. According to the bridge guard, the town is closed for outsiders to enter, and no-one is currently allowed to leave. They are investigating some disappearances of some of the townspeople.
remgard.15: I have offered my assistance in helping the people of Remgard investigate what has happened to the townspeople that have disappeared.
remgard.20: The bridge guard has asked me to investigate an abandoned house to the east along the northern shore of the lake. I should be wary of any inhabitants that may be there.
remgard.30: I have reported back to the bridge guard that I met Algangror in the abandoned house.
remgard.31: I have reported back to the bridge guard that the abandoned house was empty.
remgard.35: I have been granted entrance into Remgard. I should go visit Jhaeld, the town elder, to talk about what the next step should be. Jhaeld can probably be found in the tavern to the southeast.
remgard.40: Jhaeld was rather arrogant, but told me that they have had a problem with people disappearing for a while now. They have no clue what could be causing it.
remgard.50: I should visit four people in Remgard, and ask them about any clues on what might have happened to the missing people.
remgard.51: First is Norath, whose wife Bethir has disappeared. Norath can be found in the south-westernmost farmhouse.
remgard.52: Second, I should go talk to the Knights of Elythom, here in the tavern.
remgard.53: Third, I should go talk to the old woman Duaina in her house to the south.
remgard.54: Lastly, I should talk to Rothses, the armorer. He lives on the west side of town.
remgard.59: I tried to tell Jhaeld about Algangror, but he dismissed me as he had not heard me.
remgard.61: I have talked to Norath. He and his wife had been fighting recently, but he has no idea on what may have happened to her.
remgard.62: The Knights of Elythom in the Remgard tavern have had one of their knights disappearing recently. No one noticed anything when she disappeared, however.
remgard.63: Duaina has seen me in her visions. I did not understand all that she spoke of, but the parts that were clear were that me and Andor were parts of a larger plot. I wonder what this means? She did not speak of any disappearing people however, not that I could understand anyway.
remgard.64: Rothses told me that Bethir visited him the night before she disappeared, to sell some equipment. He did not see where she went after that.
remgard.70: I have talked to all of the people that Jhaeld wanted me to talk to, but did not get any information from any of them about what may have happened to the missing people. I should go back to Jhaeld and ask what his plans are next.
remgard.75: Jhaeld was really upset that I did not find out anything from the people that I was sent to talk to.
remgard.80: If I still want to help Jhaeld and the people of Remgard, I should look for clues in other places.
remgard.110: Jhaeld does not want to talk to me. I will not help them find out what happened to the missing people of Remgard.

Thieves03.1: Time to rest and prepare myself to start the next job. I should go to the tavern.
Thieves03.2: I really need to take a break ....
Thieves03.3: I am now fully rested, so I should go back to Umar.
Thieves03.4: Umar told me about a group of traitors led by a veteran of the Guild. It seems he stole the Key of Luthor.
Thieves03.5: Umar went on to say that this team leader  was known as "Crackshot". He is probably also the responsible for a murder on the Duleian road.
Thieves03.10: Crackshot and his henchmen are probably hiding somewhere near the Duleian road. I must ask people there whether they have seen them.
Thieves03.11: It seems that Benbyr, a suspicious man outside Crossroads Guardhouse, doesn't know what I'm talking about.
Thieves03.15: A Crossroads guard told me that Feygard has sent more soldiers to the south, to try and find the criminals' hideout.
Thieves03.20: The barricade guard has a big mouth, and told me all I needed to know. The hideout is near a place full of larval burrowers. I need to move faster than the patrols to reach the hideout before them.
Thieves03.21: I found a small hole which seems to lead to a cave. Crackshot and his henchmen are probably hiding there.
Thieves03.22: I reached the hideout and saw some recent blood stains. Maybe there was a fight there.
Thieves03.24: I heard screams and sword clashes nearby. I should take a look.
Thieves03.25: There was a massacre. The Feygard patrol reached this place, but they seem to have all been killed. I must continue.
Thieves03.26: As I progressed down the corridor the air became thicker. The blood smell was stronger, and I found another dying soldier. He said something about his sergeant and some other guy.
Thieves03.27: As I progressed down the corridor the air became thicker. The blood smell was stronger, and I found a dying soldier. He said something about his sergeant and some other guy.
Thieves03.28: I found another dying soldier. There was a massacre. The Feygard patrol reached this place, but they seem to have all been killed. I must continue.
Thieves03.30: I've found the patrol sergeant. He advised me to leave this dangerous place.
Thieves03.31: The patrol sergeant told me about what happened before. He's tired and wounded, so I willl avenge his fellows.
Thieves03.32: The patrol sergeant has left to call for backup. Now I'm alone again. Time to defeat Crackshot.
Thieves03.35: I killed Crackshot and he had the key of Luthor with him. I have to go back and report to Umar.
Thieves03.36: I tried to open the door behind Crackshot, but for some reason I cannot get the key into the lock.
Thieves03.40: The dying Crackshot said something about the key. If he told the truth, it could be cursed.
Thieves03.41: I tried to open the door behind Crackshot, but for some reason I could not get the key turned in the lock.
Thieves03.45: I reported about the situation to Umar, and gave him the key. He did not seem to want to tell me more about the key - yet.
Thieves03.50: Finally, this job is done. Now I should take a rest and regain my strength.

beer_bootlegging.10: I've agreed to help the Feygard patrol captain investigate why there is so much beer on the Foaming flask tavern property.
beer_bootlegging.20: After bribing Torilo, the owner of the Foaming flask, he stated that he and other tavern owners had a 'business agreement' with a group of 'distributors'. He suggested that I ask other tavern owners for more information.
beer_bootlegging.30: After bribing Tharwyn, the owner of the Vilegard tavern, he stated as part of his 'business agreement', Dunla, the local thief, is one of his 'distributors'. He suggested that I talk to him.
beer_bootlegging.40: Dunla, the thief in Vilegard instructed me to speak with Farrick if I want to learn more about the tavern owner's 'business agreement' with their 'distributors'.
beer_bootlegging.50: Farrik told me that the beer is coming from Sullengard. I really should go there next.
beer_bootlegging.60: To earn his trust, Mayor Ale has asked that I deliver his letter to Kealwea, the Sullengard priest.
beer_bootlegging.70: I have done what Mayor Ale has asked of me as I have delivered his letter. I should now return to him.
beer_bootlegging.80: Mayor Ale has explained everything to me about the 'business agreement' with the Thieves guild. I should head back to the Foaming flask tavern and speak with the captain.
beer_bootlegging.90: I informed the guard captain at the Foaming flask tavern all about the beer bootlegging operation.
beer_bootlegging.100: I informed the guard captain at the Foaming flask tavern that the beer was being distributed by the Thieves guild.
beer_bootlegging.110: I informed the guard captain at the Foaming flask tavern that Sullengard was responsible for brewing the beer.
beer_bootlegging.120: I lied to the guard captain at the Foaming flask tavern and told him nothing about the beer bootlegging operation.

Thieves02.2: After completing my first task I'm considered a member of Thieves' Guild. Now I have to perform a very risky task. Umar sent me to kidnap a noble woman from Feygard, without being discovered.
Thieves02.4: She was recently seen in the Foaming Flask tavern.
Thieves02.6: Umar gave me some advice. My strength is not always the solution. I must "use my tongue" to avoid raising suspicion in the tavern.
Thieves02.10: Ambelie Laumwill doesn't want to come with me peacefully. I cannot make a scene, or the guards will alert other patrols. Maybe talking with them would solve the situation.
Thieves02.15: I have "used my tongue" with the main Feygard soldier in the Foaming Flask tavern. He gave me permission to "escort back" Ambelie.
Thieves02.20: I knocked out Ambelie. I will take her back to the Guild.
Thieves02.21: I have decided not to kidnap Ambelie. I must think of another solution.
Thieves02.24: Ambelie gave me a very valuable necklace. I must talk with Umar and persuade him to no longer pursue her.
Thieves02.30: I safely brought Ambelie to the basement. However, keeping her here could be dangerous.
Thieves02.35: Umar believes there is a secure room for these types of "visitors". I should talk to Troublemaker.
Thieves02.40: I have talked to Troublemaker about the place Umar believes it's okay to safely keep the hostage.
Thieves02.45: Troublemaker has given me the key to the Guild brig. I should take Ambelie there and leave her to wake up.
Thieves02.50: I've inserted the key and moved the lever. A hatchway has opened in the room.
Thieves02.55: I left Ambelie in that ugly, dark, and cold place. I should go back.
Thieves02.60: Troublemaker gave me some bread for Ambelie. The guild doesn't want her to starve to death. Indeed, they want her to be as comfortable as possible. I must go to the brig again.
Thieves02.65: I gave the bread to Ambelie. I should report Troublemaker that I completed the job.
Thieves02.70: The job finally seems to be finished. I just have to talk with Umar again. However, I do not feel good about this. Kidnappings are definitely not my kind of job.
Thieves02.75: I completed this task successfully. Umar told me they have sent couriers to Feygard, and the ransom is almost guaranteed. He paid me for my work.
Thieves02.76: Umar took the necklace as compensation for my errors. Everything is fine again.

misc_nondisplay.20: Told by Umar to say he sent you at the inn.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
